messages.content:
The server connection to **[redoxyae.odoo.com](https://redoxyae.odoo.com)** (database: `redoxyae`, Odoo SaaS 19.3+e) is active and reachable.

To complete authentication and link the database, please provide your **Odoo API Key** (or account password) for **`remizccj@gmail.com`**.

---

### How to get your API Key (30 seconds):

1. Sign in to [redoxyae.odoo.com](https://redoxyae.odoo.com).
2. Tap your user avatar (top right) $\rightarrow$ **Preferences** (or **My Profile**).
3. Switch to the **Account Security** tab.
4. Under **Developer API Keys**, tap **New API Key** and copy it.

---

### Two ways to connect:

* **Option 1 (Fastest):** Reply directly here with your API key, and I will authenticate, verify your database access, and save the credentials to [.env](https://github.com/remizreza/connect-to-odoo-redoxyae-data-base/blob/main/.env.example).
* **Option 2:** Open the live mobile hub: **[Open Redoxyae Hub](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/ef90ea0e-7f11-4311-b62a-aff645971b78/324e49e724f21e2de2e809d0/)** (your email is already pre-filled) to generate and test the connection.
